newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asian Metals--Copper traders ponder LME stocks.
newsitem.headline: Asian Metals--Copper traders ponder LME stocks.

text.p: Movements in London Metal Exchange copper warehouse stocks remained a key concern of Japanese traders, although Japan's physical metals markets remained quiet as contract talks for 1997 supplies gathered steam, market sources said on Wednesday.

LME copper stocks have fallen sharply since early September, shedding 166,600 tonnes to 109,175 tonnes, but prices have risen only modestly amid widespread scepticism that the drawdowns are merely part of a speculative play.
